title: Flying craft through the mind for a brain neural interface
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: >> These UAP, UFO, other materials. They're not flown with joysticks. They're flown through the mind.

plain: Craft of unknown origin are not flown with joysticks but through the pilot's mind, says Jordan Jose, a man who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child and worked on a brain-to-machine interface at Baker Victory Services in Western New York between 2008 and 2010. He tells Michels that these UAP, the government's newer term for UFOs, are steered by thought. If true, it would mean someone was training children to control such craft with their minds.
